title: vendor-diligence
description: Structured second-line vendor diligence record. Carries inherent risk, criticality input, due-diligence evidence read, residual risk, exit posture, and the gap-and-question set a control owner needs to close before onboarding or recertification. The same record handles non-AI and AI vendors via the ai_vendor boolean and the conditional ai_specific_findings block. Downstream consumers: contract-gap-review, exit-plan, concentration-risk-review, dora-register-builder, llm-vendor-evidence-review (AI vendors only).

arrangement_id.description: Stable identifier for the vendor arrangement. Reused across criticality-assessment, contract-gap-review, exit-plan, and concentration-risk-review.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this diligence was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the diligence pack was last revised.

review_type.description: Why this diligence is being produced. Drives depth and review-gate set.

vendor_legal_name.description: Counterparty legal entity name. Use the contracting entity, not the brand.

vendor_brand_name.description: Brand or product name if it differs from the legal entity.

vendor_jurisdictions.description: Country / state codes where the vendor is incorporated, licensed, or hosts material services.

service_type.description: Concise service description, e.g., cloud IaaS, core banking SaaS, foundation-model API, ACH processor, KYC/CIP vendor, claims TPA, sub-adviser, fund accountant.

business_process_supported.description: Name of the firm's business process or important business service the vendor supports.

important_business_service.description: If the firm has an IBS map, the IBS the vendor sits in. Drives impact-tolerance test.

criticality.description: Sourced from criticality-assessment. The diligence pack consumes; it does not set.

criticality_source.description: Pointer to the criticality-assessment record, or 'inline' if set in this pack.

data_access.description: Categories of firm or customer data the vendor touches. Includes prompts and model outputs for AI vendors.

data_locations.description: Regions where data is processed or stored. Use ISO country codes or named cloud regions.

cross_border_flows.description: True if customer or firm data crosses a regulated border.

subcontractors.description: Material fourth parties known to be in the chain.

subcontractor_visibility.description: How much of the subcontractor chain is visible to the firm. Flow-down clauses do not count as visibility.

cyber_evidence_status.description: Read-through of SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, pen-test, vulnerability-management evidence. Scope and exceptions matter, not just clean opinion.

cyber_evidence_notes.description: What was inspected, what was missing, what CUECs are not addressed by the firm.

bcdr_evidence_status.description: Read-through of BCDR test reports against the firm's impact tolerance for the supported business service.

bcdr_meets_firm_tolerance.description: True only when the vendor's evidenced (not claimed) recovery objectives meet the firm's impact tolerance.

privacy_evidence_status.description: Read-through of GLBA Safeguards posture, state-privacy-law compliance, HIPAA BAA where applicable, AI training-data and prompt-handling commitments where applicable.

financial_condition_notes.description: What was reviewed: audited financials, public filings, D&B, credit-rating, going-concern qualifier, runway disclosure for non-public early-stage vendors.

regulatory_posture_flags.description: Sanctions, enforcement, litigation, jurisdictional or registration concerns.

contract_gap_summary.description: One-paragraph summary of contract coverage findings. Pointer to contract-gap-review record.

contract_gap_record_id.description: ID of the contract-gap-review record carrying the full clause-by-clause analysis.

exit_plan_status.description: Status of the corresponding exit-plan artifact. A critical or important vendor with exit_plan_status of 'missing' is itself a finding.

concentration_flag.description: Concentration consideration raised here; full analysis lives in concentration-risk-review.

concentration_notes.description: Why the flag was raised: hyperscaler region, BIN sponsor, sponsor-bank program, sub-adviser, claims-TPA, foundation-model concentration, etc.

ai_vendor.description: Gates the AI-specific findings block. True when the vendor supplies an AI system or AI-adjacent capability the firm relies on for inference, generation, classification, or autonomous action. Includes embedded-AI features in an otherwise non-AI SaaS.

ai_specific_findings.description: Populated only when ai_vendor is true. Captures the AI-overlay diligence findings. The narrower model-risk evidence-pack review chains to llm-vendor-evidence-review via eval_evidence_status.

model_provenance.description: Who built the model, on what base, what is licensed vs proprietary. Includes whether the deployment is base, fine-tuned, RAG-augmented, or agent-orchestrated.

training_data_posture.description: What the vendor publicly commits to on training data, customer-data-isolation, opt-out posture for API inputs, and abuse-monitoring exceptions to the default.

eval_evidence_status.description: Read-through of system-card, model-report, evaluation-report, red-team-summary against the firm's deployment context. 'deferred-to-evidence-review' means the deeper question is being handed to llm-vendor-evidence-review in ai-governance-model-risk.

eval_coverage_on_deployed_system.description: True only when published evals cover the deployed system (fine-tune + RAG + retrieval quality + grounding behavior), not only the base model on the vendor's benchmarks.

shared_responsibility_clarity.description: Clarity of the responsibility split for safety, content moderation, abuse handling, prompt-injection defence, and incident-response.

fine_tune_data_isolation.description: Posture on customer fine-tuning data and customer prompts being used to train, evaluate, or improve the vendor's models.

agent_tool_posture.description: Where the vendor offers agentic capabilities, the tool-use boundary, action-authorisation, and audit-trail posture.

system_card_fit_to_deployment.description: Whether the vendor's published system card or model report addresses the firm's actual deployment context, data, and downstream decisioning.

prompt_as_customer_data_assessment.description: Privacy lens on customer prompts. Flag NPI, PHI, PCI, or other regulated data that customer interactions may carry to the vendor.

llm_vendor_evidence_review_record_id.description: ID of the linked llm-vendor-evidence-review record (ai-governance-model-risk skill) when chained.

residual_risk.description: Residual risk after current and committed controls.

open_evidence_gaps.description: Specific evidence the firm asked for and did not receive, or received in insufficient form.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the human approver. Each question names the decision it supports.

recommended_decision.description: The diligence team's recommendation. Final decision sits with the named approver, not the skill.

recommended_conditions.description: If approve-with-conditions, the conditions the vendor or first line must meet before or after onboarding.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this pack must clear. Drawn from references/review-gates.md.

next_review_trigger.description: Annual cycle date, scope-change trigger, or incident-driven re-review condition.

owner.description: Role, not person. Examples: third-party risk manager, business owner, CISO delegate, BSA officer, AI governance lead.

approver.description: Role of the human approver named in the firm's third-party-risk policy for this criticality tier.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the overall diligence read, per references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims. Every claim should be traceable.
